chunks: Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā al-Yaqṭīnī, from Yaʿqūb ibn Yaqṭīn, who said:

I asked Abā al-Ḥasan al-Riḍā عليه السلام about the deceased: how should he be placed on the washing platform? Should his face be directed toward the qiblah, or should he be placed on his right side with his face toward the qiblah? He said: “He should be placed in whatever way is convenient, and when he has been purified, he is placed as he is placed in his grave.”

key_terms.الْقِبْلَةِ: the direction of prayer toward which the body is oriented
key_terms.الْمَيِّتِ: the deceased person whose body is being prepared
key_terms.الْمُغْتَسَلِ: the place or platform on which the deceased is washed
key_terms.طَهُرَ: was purified through the ritual washing
key_terms.قَبْرِهِ: his grave, whose burial orientation serves as the standard

ai.seo_question: How should the deceased be positioned during ghusl according to Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding how the deceased is positioned during ghusl. It states that before completion of purification, the body may be placed in whatever manner is feasible, and after purification it should be positioned in the manner it is placed in the grave, facing the qiblah.
